title: Absolute continuity of projections and dimension conservation for self-similar sets and measures
summary: Let $A\subset\mathbb{R}^d$, $d\geq3$, be the attractor of a self-similar IFS whose rotations generate a dense subgroup of $\mathrm{SO}(d)$. For every $1\leq k M\}}f_V\,d\mathcal{L}_V^k\lesssim e^{-c(\log M)^{1/3}}$. Under strong separation, the conditional measures on the fibres are exact dimensional of dimension $\dim_{\mathrm{H}}μ-k$. The proof uses self-similarity to iterate $L^1$ norms of differences of the Gaussian-smoothing of $μ_V$ between scales.
